note: LOGGED, not posted. Each starter's projection: last season per start blended with this season, moved half the way by what the opponent allows. No feed carries PrizePicks' soccer lines: set the line to the app's and the chance follows. A line you set is saved and graded at that number (ppRecord).

record.scope: the side each row leans at the line it showed, before kickoff

ppRecord.scope: the side the card showed at the PrizePicks line you set, before kickoff

fouls.note: Fouls ran below 50% at the default line; read them apart from the other stats.

picksGate.note: Soccer props stay off Picks of the day until 100-150 legs have graded at real PrizePicks lines.
